code: struct Hero: Decodable { let title: String }

. Its type cannot settle the ordering, so

The client first attempts to retrieve the story from cache (using
It then makes a network request to get the latest version, retrying transient failures.
Duplicates are filtered so the cached and fresh responses are only emitted once when identical.

A cached copy that no longer decodes into your types is passed over, as though the cache held none, rather than failing the publisher. This happens when a copy was cached before the content changed shape, such as a required field added to a block since. Only the network version failing to decode is reported, as
Stories and pages of stories are both fetched this way, through
, which you can also use directly for requests the client does not cover.
